contact-us.title: Contact HYT Engineering
contact-us.description: Contact HYT Engineering in Pune about CNC wheel lathes, wheel shop machines, turnkey workshops or service. Call, email or send an enquiry form to our team.
contact-us.lede: Tell us about your fleet, your workshop or the problem you need to solve. An application engineer will come back to you – usually with questions before answers.
contact-us.summary: Telephone, email, address and enquiry form for HYT Engineering in Pune.

blocks.heading: Talk to the people who build the machines
paragraphs: Enquiries are answered by HYT's own engineering and sales team in Pune – people who know the machines and the railway workshops they work in. Whether you are planning a new depot, replacing an old lathe or need a quotation for a single machine, the more you tell us, the more useful our first reply will be.
Helpful details include your vehicle types and fleet size, wheel diameter range and profiles, track gauge, expected wheelsets per shift and a sketch of your workshop or depot layout.
blocks.image_alt: Sample illustration of the HYT Engineering office and works in Pune

blocks.heading: Send an enquiry
blocks.intro: Use this form for product, project and service enquiries. The more detail you give, the more specific our first answer can be.

thank-you.title: Thank You – Submission Received
thank-you.description: Thank you for contacting HYT Engineering. Your submission has been received; here is what happens next and where to read more while you wait for our reply.
thank-you.h1: Thank you – we have received your details
thank-you.lede: Whether you sent an enquiry, requested a catalogue, registered as a supplier or applied for a job, your submission has reached the right team at HYT.
thank-you.summary: Confirmation that your submission has been received and what happens next.

items.title: Acknowledgement
items.text: Your submission is logged and passed to the responsible team – sales, service, purchasing or HR.

items.title: Review by a specialist
items.text: An HYT specialist reviews what you sent. If we need more information, such as wheel profiles or drawings, we will ask.

items.title: Response
items.text: We reply by email or telephone. For product enquiries this may be a recommendation, a meeting request or a technical proposal.

blocks.heading: Urgent matters
paragraphs: If a machine is down or your enquiry is time-critical, please call us during office hours on +91 20 6634 3900 or the toll-free line 1800 2100 456, and quote the details you submitted. You can also write to info@hytengineering.com.
